fee_notes: Royalty 3-12% of Gross Revenue depending on products sold (4%, 6%, 9%, 12% categories) and territory tenure. Brand Fund: 1% (first year or prior GR<$300k), 2% (prior GR $300-500k), 3% (prior GR≥$500k), reduced to 2% on GR exceeding $1M. Local Advertising: 6% of GR or $1,200 minimum (first year or prior GR<$300k), 4% (prior GR $300-500k), 3% (prior GR≥$500k). Also: Opening Advertising $5,500, Late Payment Interest (lesser of 18% or max legal rate), Convention Fees (currently $0, max $500), Per Diem $400/day, Manual Copy $1/page.
